mutmut3.progress: N/M followed by the emoji counters, e.g. `13/13  🎉 10 🫥 0 ⏰ 0 🤔 0 🙁 3 🔇 0 🧙 0`

gremlins.progress: none: one line per finished mutant (`KILLED|LIVED|NOT COVERED|SKIPPED|TIMED OUT|NOT VIABLE <TYPE> at file:line:col`)

notes: mutmut 3.8 `--version` in an unconfigured project exits 1 with a Python traceback ending `FileNotFoundError: Could not figure out where the code to mutate is. Please specify it by adding "source_paths=code_dir" in setup.cfg to the [mutmut] section.` The signature is `Could not figure out where the code to mutate is`.

mutmut 3.8 config keys (configuration.py): source_paths, pytest_add_cli_args_test_selection, pytest_add_cli_args, only_mutate, do_not_mutate, do_not_mutate_patterns, also_copy, max_stack_depth, debug, mutate_only_covered_lines, process_isolation, forkserver_warmup. Read from pyproject.toml [tool.mutmut] when that table exists, else setup.cfg [mutmut].
DEPRECATED in 3.8 (UserWarning): paths_to_mutate -> source_paths, tests_dir -> pytest_add_cli_args_test_selection. source_paths + pytest_add_cli_args_test_selection in setup.cfg produce no warning.
mutmut 3.8 defaults source_paths by guessing lib/, src/, <dirname>/ — an unconfigured project with none of those cannot even run --version.
mutant-name globs work: `mutmut run 'pkg.mod.x_b__mutmut_*' 'pkg.mod.xǁKǁm__mutmut_*'` ran only those mutants; every other mutant stays `not checked` in `results --all true`.

PYTEST_ADDOPTS=tests/test_b.py narrows the stats and clean runs ONLY when the project config has no pytest_add_cli_args_test_selection. With `pytest_add_cli_args_test_selection=tests/` (what `ac mutate setup` writes) the union still collects tests/test_a.py, so positional files do NOT narrow.

PYTEST_ADDOPTS=--ignore=tests/test_a.py DOES narrow even when the config names tests/ (collected only tests/test_b.py). So: positional files when the config has no selection, --ignore=<other test file> when it does.

`mutmut show <name>` prints a unified diff whose hunk header (`@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@`) is relative to the FUNCTION, not the file: line 1 is the def line. The real source line is the function's def line + (hunk old offset + index of the `-` line) - 1.
The generated mutants/pkg/mod.py holds, per function, `<f>` (trampoline), `x_<f>__mutmut_orig` and `x_<f>__mutmut_N`; N bodies differ from orig by one line, so a per-mutant offset needs no process.

gremlins `unleash --diff <sha>` accepts a commit sha and diffs <sha> against HEAD (committed changes): with the phase base it also covers post-phase commits, so survivors MUST be filtered back to the phase's lines.
gremlins `-o <file>` writes JSON {go_module, files:[{file_name, mutations:[{type,status,line,column}]}]}. `--exclude-files` is a repeatable regexp flag. There is no test-selection flag.

GOFLAGS='-run=^(TestSub)$' reaches gremlins' go test calls: with it a package whose tests do not match reported its mutants NOT COVERED. It narrows, but unmatched mutants read as not covered (survivor status no-coverage), so the filter must be the phase's tests for the phase's package.
gremlins prints no progress count; the step is inferred from `Gathering files diff...` / `Gathering coverage...` and the per-mutant status lines.
Stryker is not installed here and no network installs are allowed: its CLI is transcribed, marked as such, and C14 compares flags against the transcription.
gremlins --version prints `gremlins version dev linux/arm64` here (no numeric 0.x): ac's version regex finds nothing, version is null, and gremlins has no supportedMajors, so the run proceeds.

phase 49 t6 gremlins: `--diff <dangling commit>` does NOT narrow to lines (three-dot diff against the merge base; a child of HEAD gives an empty diff and Gremlins mutates everything, a parentless commit errors). Only a real ancestor works. --survivors therefore narrows Gremlins by files (-E) + kinds (--<type>=false), narrowed: 'files+kinds'.
phase 49 t6 gremlins: `--<type>=false` removes that mutant kind and `-E <regexp>` removes a file; non-default kinds need `--<type>` to be re-run.
phase 49 t6 gremlins: the module version is in the binary's build info (`mod github.com/go-gremlins/gremlins v0.6.0`), readable without spawning go; `--version` prints `dev`.

phase 49 t6 mutmut 3.8: `mutmut run <exact mutant name>...` runs exactly those (cleared cache: 2/13 tested). `mutmut show` prints a function-relative diff; string mutants are `XX..XX` wrap, case change or `None`.

phase 49 t6 runners: `go test -count=1 -v` prints `--- FAIL: <name>`; `GOFLAGS=-skip=^(TestX)$` drops it. `pytest -p no:cacheprovider -rf -q` prints `FAILED <nodeid> - ...`; `PYTEST_ADDOPTS=--deselect <nodeid>` drops it.
phase 49 t6 stryker: transcribed — the `file:L:C-L:C` --mutate form, killedBy/testFiles fields, and that the `command` runner gives no per-test attribution.

mutmut.note: scope narrowed to functions, tests from the phase's commits (PYTEST_ADDOPTS), survivors at real lines, log and full list written. Finding: `ac mutate setup` wrote source_paths=src/ for a project with a top-level package; fixed to pick the first directory with an __init__.py.

gremlins.note: --diff <phase base> and GOFLAGS -run accepted; scope narrowed to the diff; log and full list written.
